rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a large corporate group, including one formed from unrelated businesses.

example.english: This conglomerate owns many hotels across Asia.
example.traditional: 呢間集團喺亞洲有好多間酒店。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 zaap6 tyun4 hai2 aa3 zau1 jau5 hou2 do1 gaan1 zau2 dim3

rows.note: Use this specialized geological term when the conglomerate is the rock made of pebbles or gravel in a matrix.

example.english: The geologist says that layer of conglomerate formed when rounded stones were cemented together.
example.traditional: 地質學家話山入面嗰層礫岩係由圓石黏埋一齊形成。
example.jyutping: dei6 zat1 hok6 gaa1 waa6 saan1 jap6 min6 go2 cang4 lik1 ngaam4 hai6 jau4 jyun4 sek6 nim4 maai4 jat1 cai4 jing4 sing4
